scope: every sense authored in tick 5 (shard 14), drawn complete rather than sampled
authoring: parallel family-author agents, one per family, Opus 5 at xhigh. Rubric verbatim from family-author.md AND prompts identical across all 21 families - no per-family hints, no extra warnings. First tick where the authoring instrument is entirely the versioned file.
comparability: fully comparable to census 007 on both instruments; census 007 itself carried an in-prompt authoring warning that census 006 did not

entries.definition: engaged in or accustomed to close observation
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The baseline of the family - close observation stated flatly, with none of the danger *vigilant* keeps in view.
examples: caught by a couple of alert cops
alert enough to spot the opportunity when it came
constantly alert and vigilant, like a sentinel on duty

entries.definition: carefully observant or attentive; on the lookout for possible danger
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The grandest word here, promising watch so total that no possible danger slips past, where *open-eyed* claims only that the eyes are open.

entries.definition: (British informal) not to be deceived or hoodwinked
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: British informal, and it praises a different sharpness - not watching for danger but being too knowing to be taken in.

entries.definition: fully alert and watchful
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Brisk and informal, it compresses full alertness into a word you could clap someone on the shoulder with, where *vigilant* keeps it solemn.

entries.definition: always watchful
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Unsettling as much as admiring - watchfulness pictured as an eye that never closes, where *sleepless* says only that the watch never stops.
examples: to an eye like mine, a lidless watcher of the public weal

entries.definition: carefully observant or attentive; on the lookout for possible danger
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The flattest member - it names the posture of careful attention and looking out for danger without commending it the way *vigilant* does.

entries.definition: always watchful
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Puts the cost in view: the watch is unbroken, at a price of rest that *watchful* never has to pay.

entries.definition: carefully observant or attentive; on the lookout for possible danger
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and dutiful: attentiveness owed rather than merely shown, with the possible danger always in the frame.
examples: the vigilant eye of the town watch

entries.definition: carefully observant or attentive; on the lookout for possible danger
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The mildest of the danger-watching words - attention that is simply not asleep to what may be coming, well short of *argus-eyed*'s all-seeing claim.

entries.definition: engaged in or accustomed to close observation
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Shares *alert*'s definition but leans on the habit end of it - observation kept up rather than switched on.

entries.definition: fully alert and watchful
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Adds completeness to *alert* and little else - the force is all in the fully, with nothing left dozing.

entries.definition: frightening because of an awareness of danger
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The mildest force here — fear pinned to a danger you can recognise, which makes it a warning rather than the sheer horror of *horrifying*.

entries.definition: causing consternation
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Consternation at full weight — it knocks the composure sideways, where *dismaying* only unsettles it.

entries.definition: provoking horror
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Condemns as much as it describes — the horror is charged to the thing as a fault, where *horrifying* only reports the effect.

entries.definition: causing fear or dread or terror
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Broad and unspecific — it names the terror without picturing it, where *fearsome* gives the thing a shape.

entries.definition: causing fear or dread or terror
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Grave and flat, treating the terror as a settled fact of the situation with none of the flourish of *direful*.
examples: a career or vengeance so direful that London was shocked

entries.definition: causing fear or dread or terror
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The heightened form, reaching for a weight that *dire* carries without effort.
examples: a career or vengeance so direful that London was shocked

entries.definition: causing consternation
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The gentler consternation: spirits sink rather than reel, and the thing is not condemned outright as *appalling* condemns it.

entries.definition: causing fear or dread or terror
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Elevated, almost ceremonial — the terror is stated as an attribute the thing simply has, not an effect it works on you.
examples: the dread presence of the headmaster
polio is no longer the dreaded disease it once was

entries.definition: causing fear or dread or terror
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The participle turns the fear around: the thing is defined by the dread already aimed at it, where *dreadful* says it causes dread.
examples: polio is no longer the dreaded disease it once was

entries.definition: causing fear or dread or terror
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Says plainly that the thing causes dread — the workaday partner to *dread*'s elevation.

entries.definition: causing fear or dread or terror
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Points outward at what causes the fear rather than inward at whoever feels it, the opposite reading to the one the word's shape invites.

entries.definition: causing fear or dread or terror
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Concedes stature to what frightens — the terror it names is formidable, not merely nasty as in *horrible*.

entries.definition: provoking horror
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Fright rather than full horror — the same sense worn lightly enough to sound almost decorous beside *horrifying*.

entries.definition: provoking horror
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plain, all-purpose word for the quality — it states the horror without staging it.
examples: war is beyond all words horrible

entries.definition: provoking horror
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Keeps the verb's live action, the thing doing the horrifying to you as you watch, where *horrible* merely names the quality.

entries.definition: provoking horror
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Nothing to do with looks here: a blunt, unadorned word for what provokes horror, and the flatness is the whole of its force.

entries.definition: pertaining to unconventional choices
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Treats the unconventionality as something chosen, and a choice is describable without being deplored.

entries.definition: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Strong and faintly appalled — the oddity is loud enough to unsettle, not merely to be noticed.
examples: restaurants of bizarre design — one like a hat, another like a rabbit

entries.definition: marked by a carefree unconventionality or disreputableness
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Puts its weight on the carefreeness itself, which is what the word names whether the result reads as dash or as disrepute.

entries.definition: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The most tolerant reading of the same conspicuous oddity, allowing it to be indulged where *freakish* will not.

entries.definition: (informal) strikingly unconventional
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Informal, and the striking quality lands as a thrill rather than a fault — the approving end of a family whose middle condemns.

entries.definition: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The variant spelling of *flaky*, carrying the identical shrug at strangeness that will not be weighed.

entries.definition: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal and dismissive — the oddity is treated as too insubstantial to be taken seriously.

entries.definition: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Pushes the strangeness toward the unnatural, so the deviation sounds like a defect of kind rather than a quirk.

entries.definition: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The informal, offhand counterpart to *freakish*, registering the strangeness as a jolt rather than a fault.

entries.definition: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Informal and almost relishing — the same conspicuous excess sounds enjoyed here, where *freakish* deplores it.

entries.definition: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal and blunt, putting the oddity outside any expected range without making it a flaw of character.

entries.definition: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The strangeness is excessive to the edge of absurdity, and the word scorns it where *eccentric* would indulge it.

entries.definition: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal and cool, naming the same conspicuous strangeness with a raised eyebrow instead of *outlandish*'s scorn.

entries.definition: marked by a carefree unconventionality or disreputableness
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Tilts toward the disreputable half of the sense, though the carefreeness keeps it amused rather than condemning.
examples: a cocktail party given by some … raffish bachelors

entries.definition: marked by a carefree unconventionality or disreputableness
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Hears dash in the same carefree disrepute that *raffish* hears a shabbiness in.

entries.definition: not conventional or conformist
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The flat, judgement-free naming of the departure itself, which *bizarre* and *outlandish* charge up into a verdict.

entries.definition: having a body or a body of a specified kind; often used in combination
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The unmarked base of the set - it says only that a body is there, or that one of a stated kind is, and waits for a word in front of it to say which.

entries.definition: invested with a bodily form especially of a human body
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The one member that treats embodiment as something conferred rather than measured, and it carries a gravity the shape words never reach for.
examples: a monarch … regarded as a god incarnate

entries.definition: having a lithe body
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises suppleness rather than outline - where *slim-bodied* reports a shape, this admires the ease of one.

entries.definition: having a relatively long body
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Pure measurement along a single axis, and a comparative one at that - it reports length against other bodies without admiring or faulting it.

entries.definition: having a relatively narrow body
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Measures across where *long-bodied* measures along, and is just as uncommitted about whether narrowness is a virtue.

entries.definition: having an oval body
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Names a whole outline instead of one dimension - the most purely geometric word here and the least interested in judging what it draws.

entries.definition: having a relatively short body
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The mirror of *long-bodied* and just as flat - shortness is given as a proportion, not held against the thing that has it.

entries.definition: having a silver-colored body
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Turns from shape to colour, and asserts the metal outright rather than a likeness to it.

entries.definition: having a silver-colored body
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The same colour softened into resemblance - a sheen suggested where *silver-bodied* claims the metal itself.

entries.definition: having a slim body
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The most admiring way to report slimness, lending it an elegance *thin-bodied* withholds.

entries.definition: having a slim body
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Slimness stated with quiet approval - the plainest of the favourable three, complimentary without reaching for grace.

entries.definition: having a smooth body
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Reports surface rather than dimension, and the agreeableness in it belongs to the texture rather than to any verdict on the body.

entries.definition: having a thick body
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The one dimension word here that can land as a verdict instead of a measurement, reading as bulk where *slim-bodied* reads as trim.

entries.definition: having a slim body
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The same slimness with the compliment drained out - where *slim-bodied* approves, this can land as merely scant.

entries.definition: having the power or quality of deciding
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plainest member — the power or quality of deciding stated with no formality at all, where *determinative* says as much in a starched collar.

entries.definition: determining or having the power to determine an outcome
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The family's plain baseline, covering both the thing that actually determines an outcome and the thing merely holding the power to, and taking no view on how the outcome falls.
examples: two factors had a decisive influence

entries.definition: having the power or quality of deciding
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal and analytic, naming the deciding power as a property a factor holds rather than anything it is seen to do.

entries.definition: having the power or quality of deciding
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal, and tilted toward deciding as a standing quality, where *determining* is that same power caught in the act.

entries.definition: having the power or quality of deciding
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The deciding power shown in use rather than merely held, which gives it a motion *determinant* lacks.

entries.definition: having momentous consequences; of decisive importance
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The darkest way this family has of saying momentous — it makes decisive importance sound like doom arriving, where *fateful* only makes it weighty.
examples: the fatal day of the election finally arrived

entries.definition: having momentous consequences; of decisive importance
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Adds gravity to plain importance — consequences big enough to feel handed down, with a shadow across them that *deciding* has no room for.
examples: that fateful meeting of the U.N. when … it declared war on North Korea

entries.definition: putting an end to all debate or action
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Force with no courtesy in it: rather than settle an outcome it slams the door on debate and action alike, leaving nothing to answer.

entries.definition: utterly cast down
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Absolute rather than graded - 'utterly' leaves no degrees to argue about, putting it at the far end from a merely *low* mood.

entries.definition: filled with melancholy and despondency
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The softest word here - it makes despondency sound like a passing shade, understating what the sense actually covers.
examples: lonely and blue in a strange city

entries.definition: brought low in spirit
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Identical in sense to *chopfallen*, and like it stresses being brought low - a spirit put down from a height rather than one that was always down.

entries.definition: brought low in spirit
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The blunter-sounding twin of *chapfallen*: the force is in the fall, not in the level reached.

entries.definition: brought low in spirit
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Implies the spirit stood higher before it was lowered, which *gloomy* and *low* do not.

entries.definition: brought low in spirit
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Flatness rather than darkness - the spirit reads as having gone out of something, the mildest and most deadpan of the brought-low set.
examples: left us fatigued and deflated spiritually

entries.definition: affected or marked by low spirits
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plain, unmarked word for the state - it reports low spirits without the finality of *amort* or the weather of *gloomy*.
examples: is dejected but trying to look cheerful

entries.definition: filled with melancholy and despondency
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: States the weight flatly and without consolation, none of the softening that *blue* or *down* carry.
examples: depressed by the loss of his job

entries.definition: filled with melancholy and despondency
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names the loss rather than the mood - the spirit has been drained out, which registers as depletion beside *gloomy*'s heaviness.
examples: a dispirited and resigned expression on her face

entries.definition: filled with melancholy and despondency
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal and brief; it says the level and stops, understating beside *depressed*.

entries.definition: filled with melancholy and despondency
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal and faintly wry - it points at a visible droop instead of naming the feeling, making the state sound smaller than it is.

entries.definition: filled with melancholy and despondency
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: More picture than *down* - the whole bearing is lowered, not only the mood.

entries.definition: filled with melancholy and despondency
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Gentle and sympathetic, seating the despondency in the heart and inviting comfort where *grim* forecloses it.

entries.definition: filled with melancholy and despondency
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Suffuses rather than strikes - the despondency reads as a settled climate around the person, where *deflated* reads as one blow.
examples: gloomy at the thought of what he had to face

entries.definition: filled with melancholy and despondency
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Hard-edged where *gloomy* is merely overcast - melancholy that has set and will not be coaxed out of.
examples: took a grim view of the economy

entries.definition: filled with melancholy and despondency
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The barest term available - it gives the level and nothing else, so *downhearted*'s warmth and *grim*'s hardness both fall away.

entries.definition: not affected by jaundice
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Clinical and purely negative in shape, saying only that jaundice is absent and carrying none of the approval the rest of the family trades in.

entries.definition: vigorously healthy
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Health with energy spilling out of it, so where *healthy* reports a condition this one moves.

entries.definition: possessing the tone and resiliency of healthy tissue
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Judges health by touch, tone and resilience in the tissue itself, not the colour *rosy* shows nor the vigour *bouncing* spends.

entries.definition: having the pinkish flush of health
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Reads health off the skin's colour instead of declaring it, offering evidence where *healthy* offers a judgement.

entries.definition: endowed with or exhibiting great bodily or mental health
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Treats great health of body or mind as something carried in the constitution, possessed as much as shown.

entries.definition: in excellent physical condition
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The unshowy top of the scale, excellent condition stated without a flourish where *hale* reaches for one.
examples: I still have one good leg

entries.definition: exhibiting or restored to vigorous good health
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and a little grand, and it covers vigour regained as readily as vigour never lost.

entries.definition: having or indicating good health in body or mind; free from infirmity or disease
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The flat baseline of the family, a verdict passed on body or mind alike with none of the visible glow *rosy* insists on.

entries.definition: consuming abundantly and with gusto
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approves through appetite, abundance taken with relish, so it praises how someone eats rather than how they are.

entries.definition: endowed with or exhibiting great bodily or mental health
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Pitches the same great bodily or mental health as raw force, louder and more physical than *full-blooded*.

entries.definition: endowed with or exhibiting great bodily or mental health
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Sounds like a boast, great health of body or mind worn as vitality rather than merely reported as *healthy* would.

entries.definition: having the pinkish flush of health
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Puts the same pink flush in one place, the cheeks, which turns *flushed*'s observation into a portrait.

entries.definition: having the pinkish flush of health
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Spells out where *rosy*'s glow sits, and the extra word makes it fonder and more picturesque.

entries.definition: having the pinkish flush of health
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The single unadorned stroke of the pink-flush words, letting the glow stand alone rather than pinning it to a face as *rosy-cheeked* does.

entries.definition: in excellent physical condition
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Says the same excellent condition as *good* with the ring of a verdict rather than a compliment.
examples: a sound mind in a sound body

entries.definition: exhibiting or restored to vigorous good health
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Frames that same vigorous health as entirety, leaning on the restored side where *hale* leans on the display.

entries.definition: showing utter resignation or hopelessness
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The most degrading member: utter resignation or hopelessness worn openly, so that the giving-up is itself what gets judged.

entries.definition: offering little or no hope
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Paints the little-or-no hope rather than measuring it, and paints it unrelieved, which is what puts it past *dim*.

entries.definition: offering little or no hope
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The same shortage of hope felt as bareness and exposure rather than as the darkness of *black*.
examples: Life in the Aran Islands has always been bleak and difficult

entries.definition: arising from or marked by despair or loss of hope
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Points at the despair itself, whether a thing arises from that loss of hope or merely bears its mark, where *hopeless* points at the prospects.
examples: a despairing view of the world situation
the last despairing plea of the condemned criminal

entries.definition: arising from or marked by despair or loss of hope
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The straining side of the same despair — something arising from lost hope rather than merely showing it, so it pushes where *despairing* only mourns.
examples: helpless and desperate — as if at the end of his tether

entries.definition: without or almost without hope
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A sunk, settled state with hope gone or all but gone, heavier than *dim* and far quieter than *desperate*.

entries.definition: offering little or no hope
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The mildest of the three, since it sits on the “little” rather than the “no” — hope faint but not yet out.
examples: took a dim view of things

entries.definition: marked by or showing hopelessness
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Hopelessness that is marked or shown in a way inviting pity, not the reproach *abject* invites.

entries.definition: having no prospect or hope of a future
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Turns the loss forward — neither prospect nor hope of a future — a flat structural verdict beside the mood of *forlorn*.

entries.definition: without or almost without hope
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts that same absent-or-nearly-absent hope in the body, a sickness felt rather than the low weight of *despondent*.

entries.definition: unable to function; without help
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Two failures at once, no power to function and no help at hand, which makes it sound like a plea rather than the verdict *hopeless* delivers.

entries.definition: without hope because there seems to be no possibility of comfort or success
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The family's plain verdict, hope absent because no comfort or success looks possible — a reading of the odds where *despairing* is a reading of the feeling.
examples: in an agony of hopeless grief
with a hopeless sigh he sat down

entries.definition: without hope of solution
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The member aimed at what admits no solution rather than at anyone, a flat statement that none is to be hoped for, carrying no reproach of its own.

entries.definition: unable to function; without help
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Carries the same inability and the same want of help as *helpless*, but as a settled condition rather than a moment of one, so it sounds past rescue.

entries.definition: showing utter resignation or hopelessness
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A bare negation covering the same utter resignation or hopelessness as *abject*, but with the contempt drained out and understatement left to carry it.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Openly contemptuous rather than merely absolute - it disparages the thing it magnifies, where *complete* only measures it.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plainest amplifier of the set - it adds fullness and takes whatever scorn is already in the noun.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Totalizes with an air of accomplishment, as though the quality had been brought to a finish, and that mismatch gives it a wryness *utter* has none of.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Condemning - it presents the quality as set fast and past removing, going further than *thorough*, which only says it runs all the way through.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Carries exasperation into the intensifier, insisting the quality will not let up, where *utter* simply fixes its extent.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt and coarse - it enlarges the quality and looks down on it in a single move.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Turns a word of flawlessness into a measure of extent, and gains its edge over *complete* through that mismatch.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Intensifies by denying any admixture - the quality stands undiluted, which is a different claim from *utter*'s nothing-left-over.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: British and profane - the most abusive of these, spending contempt before it has said anything about degree at all.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Makes the quality conspicuous as well as total - impossible to overlook, where *utter* says nothing about how visible it is.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Bleak in its emphasis, leaving the quality bare and unrelieved rather than merely entire as *complete* does.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Amplifies by saying the quality runs the whole way through, a claim about extent with no scorn of its own.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Heavier on the tongue than *thorough*, and the extra weight is insistence on completeness rather than added disparagement.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The most deliberate of these amplifiers, spelling out that nothing has been mixed in to weaken the quality where *pure* asserts it in a breath.

entries.definition: not diminished or moderated in intensity or severity; sometimes used as an intensifier
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names the absence of relief - the intensity or severity has had nothing taken off it - where *utter* only says the quality is entire.

entries.definition: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flat and absolute - it allows no remainder, and unlike *arrant* it supplies no sneer of its own.

entries.definition: investing with dignity or honor
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Names what confers standing rather than what holds it - the honour is being handed over, where *noble* already has it.
examples: the dignifying effect of his presence

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The measured word for that height, stating the value with no lift in the voice at all.

entries.definition: investing with dignity or honor
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: More lift than *dignifying*: it raises what it touches rather than only decorating it with honour.
examples: the ennobling influence of cultural surroundings

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Reverent praise - it speaks of the height as though awe were owed to it, where *elevated* just records the same height.

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises the sheer scale of the elevation where *exalted* praises its worth, so it impresses more than it moves.

entries.definition: noble and generous in spirit
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The warm end of the family - nobility felt as open generosity, and plain-spoken where *magnanimous* is formal.

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The most emphatic in manner - elevation pitched loudly enough to be heard, where *elevated* keeps its voice level.
examples: argue in terms of high-flown ideals

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Sober, earnest approval: it admires the height without supplying any of the grandeur *grand* does.

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The least awed of these - it credits the pitch of the standard rather than any grandeur in the thing.

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Height with distance in it - approving, but it sets the thing above the ordinary rather than among it.

entries.definition: noble and generous in spirit
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The formal, weighty word for that same generous nobility, stated as a virtue rather than felt as warmth.

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Puts *noble* in plainer and more personal terms, naming high character straight out without the ceremony *exalted* carries.

entries.definition: having or showing or indicative of high or elevated character
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The family's base term for the thing itself: it takes in character that is high, character that shows it, and anything that merely points to it.

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise with thin air in it: the elevation is so far up that it reads as select rather than shared.

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same select, thin-aired elevation as *rarefied*, spelled the other way.

entries.definition: of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The furthest reach here - elevation that overwhelms rather than merely impresses, beside which *grand* is only large.

entries.definition: advanced in years; (‘aged’ is pronounced as two syllables)
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal and weighty where *older* is merely comparative, presenting advanced years as a settled condition rather than a point on a scale.

entries.definition: growing old
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The British spelling of the same word, carrying the identical sense of decline already under way.

entries.definition: growing old
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts age in motion rather than in place - the process, not the state - and that forward motion carries its faint edge of decline.

entries.definition: very old
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Pure intensification — *old* taken to its limit, and the size of the exaggeration is what gives it its edge.

entries.definition: of or like a feeble old woman
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal in shape but withering in effect, covering both actually being a feeble old woman and merely resembling one, with the contempt built into the word rather than the sentence.

entries.definition: being at least 100 years old
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely quantitative — it fixes a number where *ancient* only gestures at extremity, and passes no verdict with it.

entries.definition: (of fabrics and paper) grown dark in color over time
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The one member describing what time does to the colour of a material rather than to a life, and it carries no judgement at all.
examples: the darkened margins of the paper

entries.definition: mentally or physically infirm with age
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Contemptuous where *aged* is not, making the infirmity — of mind or of body — the whole of what it says about the person.
examples: his mother was doddering and frail

entries.definition: mentally or physically infirm with age
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The same verdict of age-borne infirmity as *doddering*, its shorter form making the mockery sound offhand rather than deliberate.
examples: his mother was doddering and frail

entries.definition: advanced in years; (‘aged’ is pronounced as two syllables)
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The courteous way to say advanced in years, gentler in force than *aged* and careful to claim nothing further about the person.
examples: elderly residents could remember the construction of the first skyscraper

entries.definition: mentally or physically infirm with age
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal and blunt — the same infirmity as *doddering*, named in a word too flippant to leave the person any dignity.

entries.definition: having attained a specific age; (‘aged’ is pronounced as one syllable)
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely a threshold reached, with none of the weight of accumulated years that *aged* brings with it.

entries.definition: (used especially of persons) having lived for a relatively long time or attained a specific age
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flat and unloaded, and it holds both readings at once — a long life lived or simply a stated age attained — where *of age* carries only the second.

entries.definition: advanced in years; (‘aged’ is pronounced as two syllables)
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A comparative doing the work of a plain description, which is what makes it the softest term here — it implies a scale instead of naming a state.

entries.definition: growing old
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Clinical and detached: it states the same growing old as *aging* in a register that declines to feel anything about it.

entries.definition: advanced in years; (‘aged’ is pronounced as two syllables)
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Carries a note of standing rather than decline, making it the one flattering way in this set to say advanced in years.

entries.definition: expecting a rise in prices
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Positional rather than evaluative: it names an expectation that prices will rise, taking no view of the person holding it the way *optimistic* does.

entries.definition: pleasantly (even unrealistically) optimistic
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Leads with the pleasantness and leaves the unrealism in the background, where *pollyannaish* brings it to the front.

entries.definition: expecting the best in this best of all possible worlds
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The unmarked term for expecting the best, and the only one here that neither congratulates the expectation nor doubts it.

entries.definition: pleasantly (even unrealistically) optimistic
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Hangs its whole weight on the unrealistic half of the same pleasant optimism, so the good cheer itself becomes the failing.

entries.definition: reflecting optimism
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Puts the optimism into what is being shown rather than into the one holding it, so it colours a view instead of judging a temperament.
examples: looked at the world through rose-colored glasses

entries.definition: reflecting optimism
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The shorter, warmer form beside *rose-colored*, and the readier of the two to stand as simple praise for how a prospect looks.
examples: looked at the world through rose-colored glasses

entries.definition: confidently optimistic and cheerful
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Adds steadiness to the cheer: confidence held, not merely expectation entertained, which is what lifts it past *optimistic*.

entries.definition: confidently optimistic and cheerful
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The heavier, more formal twin of *sanguine* for the same confident cheer, the weight falling on the word rather than the mood.

entries.definition: unrealistically or naively optimistic
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Marks the optimism as a fault either way — whether it has outrun the facts or never met them — and the dreaminess is the point.

entries.definition: pleasantly (even unrealistically) optimistic
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Buoyant and forward-leaning where *cheerful* is merely pleasant, and it carries the least doubt of the three.

entries.definition: thrown into a state of disarray or confusion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Of a thing thrown into disarray rather than snapped in two - the confusion reads as damage done to it, not merely order gone missing.

entries.definition: lacking a visible order or organization
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Sharpens the charge into a spectacle - not a trace of order or organization to be seen, where *disorganized* merely notes the lack.

entries.definition: thrown into a state of disarray or confusion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts the muddle in the thing itself rather than in anyone's head - it is the arrangement that is tangled, not a mind.
examples: a confused mass of papers on the desk

entries.definition: thrown into a state of disarray or confusion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flattest of these - it records that order has given way to disarray and stops there, where *broken* wants you to feel the blow.

entries.definition: lacking order or methodical arrangement or function
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Carries exactly the force of *disorganized*; the spelling is the whole of the difference.

entries.definition: lacking order or methodical arrangement or function
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The family's plain statement of the fault - order, methodical arrangement and working function all simply absent, with none of the wreckage *chaotic* pictures.
examples: a thousand pages of muddy and disorganized prose
she was too disorganized to be an agreeable roommate

entries.definition: snarled or stalled in complete confusion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Coarse and total - a snarl or dead stop treated as a botch someone is answerable for, the harshest word in the family.

entries.definition: lacking a visible order or organization
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Its jingling shape makes the same invisible order sound hectic and headlong, far lighter in judgement than *chaotic*.

entries.definition: thrown together in a disorderly fashion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Faults the making rather than the thing: pieces flung together in haste, so the disorder sits in how it was put together.

entries.definition: snarled or stalled in complete confusion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names the same total snarl-up or standstill with a clipped, almost breezy label - rueful where *fucked-up* is furious.

entries.definition: thrown into a state of disorganization or incoherence
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Sounds the same collapse as an unmaking, graver and more final than *unstuck* - the thing not merely loosened but ruined.

entries.definition: not efficient or methodical
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The coolest reproach here - it faults the missing method and the inefficiency that comes with it, and pictures no wreckage at all.
examples: the project failed through unmethodical planning

entries.definition: thrown into a state of disorganization or incoherence
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Pictures the collapse as a coming-apart - what was holding gives way, and the disorganization or incoherence follows from that.
examples: price programs became unstuck because little grain was available

entries.definition: thrown into a state of disarray or confusion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Pictures the disarray as a tipping-over: the arrangement knocked out of place rather than destroyed, and the upheaval still fresh.

entries.definition: radically new or original
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approval for newness pushed to its edge, where the break with what came before is the whole of the claim - a bigger assertion than *fresh* makes.

entries.definition: radically new or original
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises the same radical newness as *avant-garde* but hears nerve in it, as though the thing is new because someone risked making it so.

entries.definition: done by hand without mechanical aids or devices
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely a statement of method - the hand working without mechanical aid or device - and it carries none of the approval the words beside it do.

entries.definition: done by hand without mechanical aids or devices
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Says exactly what *freehand* says and no more, still describing how a thing was done rather than passing any judgement on it.

entries.definition: original and of a kind not seen before
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The warmest of the three that share this sense: not merely without precedent but welcome for it, where *new* only records the absence.

entries.definition: containing seeds of later development
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise pointed forward - the thing is valued for the later development it holds in seed, not for what it already amounts to.

entries.definition: being or producing something like nothing done or experienced or created before
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The most emphatic way to say it - first through unbroken ground - where *innovative* states the same feat without the flourish.

entries.definition: being or producing something like nothing done or experienced or created before
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The dry variant of *innovative*, sounding more like a classification of the thing than any compliment paid to it.
examples: a mind so innovational, so original

entries.definition: being or producing something like nothing done or experienced or created before
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approval that lands on the making: not simply that a thing is unprecedented but that someone brought something unprecedented about.
examples: innovative members of the artistic community

entries.definition: original and of a kind not seen before
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plainest way to make the claim - a thing is original and unlike anything seen before - with almost no approval loaded onto it.

entries.definition: original and of a kind not seen before
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Cooler and more formal than *fresh*, treating the unlikeness to anything before as a fact worth remarking rather than a pleasure.
examples: the computer produced a completely novel proof of a well-known theorem

entries.definition: being or productive of something fresh and unusual; or being as first made or thought of
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Does double duty - mild approval for something fresh and unusual, and a flat statement that a thing stands as first made or thought of.

entries.definition: containing seeds of later development
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The flattest of the three: it credits the power to start something without *germinal*'s picture of a seed and its growth.

entries.definition: containing seeds of later development
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The heaviest praise here, treating the thing as the source everything afterwards grows out of - a standing *germinal* only promises.
examples: seminal ideas of one discipline can influence the growth of another

entries.definition: not derivative or imitative
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise made by subtraction: it clears a thing of owing itself to a source and of copying a model, without claiming freshness the way *original* does.

entries.definition: fanatically patriotic
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Condemning: the country's superiority held as an article of faith, all conviction and no judgement.

entries.definition: fanatically patriotic
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Mocks the display rather than the belief, reducing the fanaticism to noisy show where *chauvinistic* attacks the conviction behind it.

entries.definition: fanatically patriotic
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The sharpest edge in the group, hearing the fanaticism as belligerence rather than mere excess of zeal.

entries.definition: inspired by love for your country
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Casts the same love as steadfast attachment rather than ardour, quieter and less demonstrative than *patriotic*.

entries.definition: fanatically patriotic
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The coolest-sounding of the fanatical set, naming the excess as a doctrine where *flag-waving* names its noise.

entries.definition: inspired by love for your country
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain approving word for love of country, holding the feeling at a warmth that *jingoistic* has already burned past.

entries.definition: fanatically patriotic
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Sarcastic: patriotism inflated past the point of belief, so the swelling itself is the accusation.

entries.definition: fanatically patriotic
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Pushed past *nationalistic* to an extremity that leaves no reading in which the word admires what it describes.

entries.definition: lasting a long time
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Makes long duration sound like constancy, where *enduring* makes it sound like resistance.

entries.definition: continuing forever or indefinitely
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Lofty and bookish — endlessness stated in the grandest available terms with no judgement attached to it.

entries.definition: continuing forever or indefinitely
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The one admiring member here — it presents going on indefinitely as something to be envied rather than merely measured, unlike *perpetual*.
examples: the ageless themes of love and revenge

entries.definition: lasting a long time
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Long duration framed as strength, as though the thing had to hold out to reach it.

entries.definition: continuing forever or indefinitely
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Carries the same elevated, uncommitted weight as *aeonian*, adding nothing and softening nothing.

entries.definition: continuing forever or indefinitely
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Solemn and absolute — it makes endlessness a property of the thing rather than a stretch of time, and still approves of nothing.

entries.definition: continuing forever or indefinitely
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Warmer than *eternal* — the endlessness sounds like something held onto rather than a fact declared.

entries.definition: lasting a long time
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The strongest of the long-lasting three: not holding out like *enduring* but beyond decay altogether, which treats what it names as worth keeping.

entries.definition: continuing or enduring without marked change in status or condition or place
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Softer than *permanent* — duration sounds like something the thing has rather than a status fixed onto it.

entries.definition: continuing or enduring without marked change in status or condition or place
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flat and factual — the bare statement that a condition holds, without the warmth *lasting* can pick up.

entries.definition: continuing forever or indefinitely
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Endlessness as plain mechanism, running on without the grandeur *eternal* brings to the same span.

entries.definition: not created for a particular occasion
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Positional rather than evaluative — it marks a thing as kept ready for whatever comes instead of raised for one occasion.

entries.definition: continuing forever or indefinitely
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Presses on the missing pause, so what continues indefinitely reads as relentless rather than simply long.

entries.definition: continuing forever or indefinitely
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Frames going on forever as the absence of any stop, which makes it sound wearing where *everlasting* makes it sound treasured.

entries.definition: not suitable or right or appropriate
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flattest disapproval here - it marks a thing as not fitting without naming the standard it fails, where *unseemly* and *indecent* both point at one.
examples: slightly improper to dine alone with a married man
improper attire for the golf course

entries.definition: not in accord with established usage or procedure
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Cooler and more technical than *wrong* - the same failure to accord with established procedure, stated as a matter of record.
examples: it is incorrect for a policeman to accept gifts

entries.definition: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt and severe where *indecorous* is measured - the same breach of what polite society accepts, named with nothing held back.

entries.definition: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal and cool, faulting the breach as a lapse of decorum rather than an outrage, which is exactly where it parts from *indecent*.

entries.definition: improper or even offensive
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Mild in shape but broad in reach - it runs from merely improper right through to offensive, and the understatement is what makes the far end land.

entries.definition: improper or even offensive
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The spaced spelling carries the same span, improper at its softest and offensive at its hardest, with no more heat in it than *out-of-the-way*.

entries.definition: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Measures the breach against whoever commits it - the conduct falls below what suits them, where *indecorous* faults the conduct alone.

entries.definition: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Faint and formal - it registers the breach of accepted standards as unattractive rather than shocking, staying well back from *indecent*.

entries.definition: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Firm and plain-spoken: the conduct does not fit at all, which is more pointed than *indecorous* and less scandalized than *indecent*.

entries.definition: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The most restrained of this set, glancing at the breach rather than rebuking it as *unseemly* does.
examples: moved to curb their untoward ribaldry

entries.definition: not in accord with established usage or procedure
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely a measure against established usage or procedure - it records a mismatch rather than passing judgement, which is what separates it from *improper*.
examples: the wrong way to shuck clams

entries.definition: causing or tending to cause anger or resentment
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The participle keeps the effect live - anger and resentment being stirred now, where *agitative* states a settled property.

entries.definition: causing or tending to cause anger or resentment
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Flat and clinical for what it describes, labelling a thing as anger-producing by disposition rather than catching the anger or resentment in the act.

entries.definition: disturbingly provocative
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The disturbance is set before you as something to be met, so the discomfort arrives with a demand attached rather than a verdict.

entries.definition: capable of producing violent emotion or arousing controversy
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names a load waiting to go off, the violent feeling or the controversy stored in the thing and not yet released, where *inflammatory* names something already doing the work.
examples: the highly charged issue of abortion

entries.definition: arousing to action or rebellion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Carries the image of a fire set on purpose, so stirring people to act or to rise is treated as damage waiting to happen.

entries.definition: arousing to action or rebellion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A bare, near-technical label for the same power to move people to action or revolt, with none of the heat *incendiary* puts under it.

entries.definition: arousing to action or rebellion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The heat is the whole point - it treats the thing as what sets the action or the rebellion alight, not merely the occasion for it.

entries.definition: arousing to action or rebellion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Points past the blaze to the hand behind it, naming what starts the action or the rising rather than how fiercely it burns.

entries.definition: disturbingly provocative
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Here the disturbance pulls instead of repelling - what unsettles is also what fascinates, where *challenging* wants an answer out of you.

entries.definition: serving or tending to provoke, excite, or stimulate; stimulating discussion or exciting controversy
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The neutral base of the family - it names the power to excite, stimulate or set off controversy without settling whether that is welcome, where *provoking* fixes the reaction as anger.
examples: provocative Irish tunes which … compel the hearers to dance

entries.definition: causing or tending to cause anger or resentment
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt and personal beside the clinical *agitative* - the anger or resentment it names is felt as an affront by someone in particular.
examples: a provoking delay at the airport

entries.definition: arousing to action or rebellion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Contempt running both ways - it belittles those stirred to act as a mob and denies the stirring any cause worth having.

entries.definition: rousing to activity or heightened action as by spurring or goading
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The one stirring in the family that is welcome, though the spurring and goading in it keep an edge of being driven to act rather than persuaded.
examples: tossed a rousing political comment into the conversation

entries.definition: arousing to action or rebellion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The gravest word here - it treats rousing people to action or revolt as an offence against authority, where *incendiary* only warns of the fire.

entries.definition: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt mockery that explains the unseriousness by putting air where the thinking should be, where *frivolous* just reports the lack.

entries.definition: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Whirl rather than vacancy, the lightest hit in the group and closer to teasing than to the contempt in *empty-headed*.

entries.definition: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flattest insult in the set: it does not merely find the person unserious but asserts there is nothing inside to be serious with.

entries.definition: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Mockery by weighing the brain, making the frivolity ridiculous rather than merely noting it as *silly* does.

entries.definition: guided by whim and fancy
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Whim read as unreliability, so it warns about conduct where *head-in-the-clouds* only pictures a drift.

entries.definition: showing inappropriate levity
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The verdict is built in, the levity being out of place, so the word rebukes a manner rather than diagnosing a mind as *empty-headed* does.

entries.definition: guided by whim and fancy
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The lightest reading of a life run by whim and fancy: loose and ungoverned rather than a fault to be answered for.

entries.definition: not serious in content or attitude or behavior
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The family's plain term and its widest, attaching to content, attitude or behaviour alike without the picture of a hollow head that the compounds beside it supply.

entries.definition: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Lightness with a lift to it, the unseriousness felt as high spirits, so it stings far less than *empty-headed*.

entries.definition: guided by whim and fancy
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Indulgent almost to fondness, the whim and fancy carrying the person off rather than damning them, unlike *scatterbrained*'s charge of disorder.

entries.definition: silly or trivial
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: It runs to two things at once, the silly and the trivial, so the dismissal is as much about weightlessness as about foolishness.

entries.definition: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The same charge as *giddy* stated as a property of the head rather than a mood, and a light head is still not the vacant one *empty-headed* alleges.

entries.definition: showing inappropriate levity
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The measured version of *flippant*'s fault, locating the misplaced levity in a cast of mind instead of throwing it back at the offender.

entries.definition: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The unhyphenated twin of *light-headed*, identical in force: a light head, not an empty one.

entries.definition: guided by whim and fancy
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Whim as scatter: the fault is that attention will not hold together, which *flighty* leaves as mere changeability.

entries.definition: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plainest and most forgiving word for the fault, naming the frivolity without a metaphor for the head and leaving room for fondness that *airheaded* forecloses.

entries.definition: avoiding waste
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The cool one of the waste-avoiders — credits efficiency without implying any self-denial, which is what *frugal* adds.

entries.definition: avoiding waste
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same waste-avoidance as *economical*, but worn as a discipline rather than run as an efficiency.
examples: She kept a frugal kitchen and wasted nothing.

entries.definition: thrifty in small matters only
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Faint mockery — grants real thrift but confines it to small sums, so the praise arrives already qualified.

entries.definition: characterized by thriftiness
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The flat attributive — ascribes thriftiness as a standing trait without pressing the approval *thrifty* carries.
examples: wealthy by inheritance but saving by constitution

entries.definition: avoiding waste
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Barbed — the identical waste-avoidance of *economical* recast as an accusation of tightness.

entries.definition: avoiding waste
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Neutral — names the holding back itself and leaves it unjudged, where *thrifty* has already decided the holding back is good.
examples: a sparing father and a spending son
sparing in their use of heat and light

entries.definition: avoiding waste
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Tips into fault — the restraint reads as giving less than is due, where *sparing* keeps the same restraint blameless.

entries.definition: careful and diligent in the use of resources
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approving outright - care with resources treated as a settled virtue, where *penny-wise* grants that same care in miniature.
examples: A thrifty family that saved on small things to afford big ones.

entries.definition: worthy of high praise
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The most demonstrative way to claim high praise, casting approval as something shown rather than merely stated, where *commendable* keeps it measured.
examples: applaudable efforts to save the environment

entries.definition: worthy of high praise
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Measured and official, granting high praise as though it were being formally entered rather than felt.

entries.definition: worthy of often limited commendation
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise with a ceiling built in - it grants real merit while conceding the commendation is a limited one, stopping well short of *commendable*.
examples: the student's effort on the essay — though not outstanding — was creditable

entries.definition: with honor; with academic distinction
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A fixed formal honors formula, conferring academic distinction by rank instead of describing what earned it.

entries.definition: (often used ironically) worthy of being treated in a particular way
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Neutral on its face: it fixes only that some treatment is fitting, never that the treatment is a good one, which is exactly what lets it turn ironic.

entries.definition: worthy of imitation
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The strongest claim here - not merely praised but held up as the standard others should copy.

entries.definition: worthy of high praise
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The most formal of the high-praise set, elevated enough to sound ceremonious beside plainer *praiseworthy*.
examples: applaudable efforts to save the environment
laudable motives of improving housing conditions

entries.definition: with high honor; with high academic distinction
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The graded step above *cum laude*, raising the honor a rank while keeping the same formal formula.

entries.definition: deserving reward or praise
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plainer formation of the same claim, carrying the earned reward without the ceremonious ring of *meritorious*.

entries.definition: deserving reward or praise
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Adds the idea of something owed - the praise is earned, and a reward is due along with it.

entries.definition: worthy of imitation
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Fastens to the thing as a label rather than a verdict, naming it the pattern to be imitated where *exemplary* judges it.

entries.definition: worthy of high praise
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Names high praise directly and without ornament, saying what *laudable* says with none of its formality.
examples: a significant and praiseworthy increase in computer intelligence

entries.definition: suitable for or worthy of quotation
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The mildest and most particular worth in the family, judging fitness for quotation as much as merit in it.
examples: his remarks are not quotable in mixed company

entries.definition: worthy of respect or dedication
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Asks for reverence rather than applause - what it marks is to be respected or given over to, not simply admired as *worthy* things are.
examples: saw motherhood as woman's sacred calling

entries.definition: (often used ironically) worthy of being treated in a particular way
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The barer form of the same judgement, stating that a treatment is merited without the weight *deserving* carries, and equally able to land ironically.

entries.definition: having worth or merit or value; being honorable or admirable
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain baseline of the family, covering both simply having value and being honorable, without fixing what praise is owed.
